decisions.reasoning: NVDA has beaten EPS four consecutive quarters, yet the last two prints sold off post-earnings (-3.4% and -7.0% at T+2), showing routine beats are fully priced while the stock enters this print in a short-term downtrend below its 5/15-day MAs after Friday's risk-off session; put skew is elevated (deep-OTM puts ~140% IV vs ~103% for calls), signaling hedging demand. With ATM IV at 114% and the ~9.5% implied straddle move already at/above the historical average absolute reaction (~8.9%), naked longs and straddles carry poor risk/reward into certain IV crush. A modest ATM/OTM bear put spread (~$3.22 debit) captures the 'good-but-not-good-enough' scenario (-4% to -7%) while capping worst-case loss at ~$3.2k if the AI narrative reignites an upside blowout.
